items.title: What a good guide includes
bullets: The Scripture reference, the purpose, and one clear big idea.
Enough context for the group to locate the passage.
A response and a prayer, kept in proportion to the time you have.

items.title: Asking questions
bullets: Move from observation, to meaning, to application.
Go further than “What did you think?”
Let application come from what the text says, not from a list of tips.
